title: Borrow Yourself
goal: cost() is called twice on the same package. Pick the form that survives the first call.
hints: Look at how many times main calls the method.
One of these forms takes the package away.
explanation: `&self` borrows the package for the call, so the second call still has something to work with. `self` would consume it on the first call and the second is then error `E0382`, use of a moved value. This is the most common shape of that error in real code.
